author: Sablinova
install_msg:
Thank you for installing GameDL!
Use `[p]gamedl <game name>` to search and extract PC game download links across supported sources.
name: GameDL
short: Search and extract direct PC game download links.
description: Searches supported direct sources for PC games and extracts direct download links (BZZHR, Gofile, PixelDrain, MegaDB, DataNodes, FileKeeper, FileDitch, 1Fichier, FileQ, Torrent, etc.), file size, and version info with rich Discord embeds and interactive download buttons.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store end user data.
